title: Restriction fibrations for diagrams with cocartesian marked edges
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, quasicategories, coherent functor simplicial sets and full subcategories of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], categorical fibrations (inner fibrations lifting equivalence edges with specified source) of [lem-coef-infinity-isofibration-exponentiation], and cocartesian edges of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. Let $r:E\to P$ be a categorical fibration of quasicategories. Let $K$ be a small simplicial set, let $A\subseteq K$ be a simplicial subset, and let $f:K\to P$ be a simplicial map. Mark a set $M\subseteq K_1$ containing all degenerate edges, and give $A$ the inherited marking $M_A=M\cap A_1$.

Define $\operatorname{Lift}_f(K,E)$ in simplicial degree $d$ to consist of maps $H:K\times\Delta^d\to E$ with $rH=f\operatorname{pr}_K$, with operators given by restriction. Let $\operatorname{Lift}^{M}_f(K,E)$ be its full subcategory on those vertices $H:K\to E$ for which every edge of $M$ has $r$-cocartesian image. Use the same construction on $A$ and $f|_A$.

Both marked lift categories are quasicategories, and restriction is a categorical fibration
$$\operatorname{Lift}^{M}_f(K,E)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Lift}^{M_A}_{f|_A}(A,E).$$
The marked lift category is closed under equivalence edges in the unmarked lift category: if $H$ is a marked lift and $H\simeq H'$ over the identity of $f$, then $H'$ is a marked lift. All transformations and higher simplices in the displayed categories remain over the identity of $f$ or $f|_A$. No cocartesian lifts of other base arrows, operadic Segal conditions, approximation hypothesis, or existence of a marked lift is assumed.
